# KM100 Inventory Management System

> Official physical custody and inventory management platform for KM100 Skills and Training Center, Inc.

## Institutional Facilities & Sections
- [Facility Rooms Catalog](https://km100-inventory.local/#rooms): Comprehensive equipment registers categorized across training suites and workshops.
- [Property Custody Register](https://km100-inventory.local/#inventory): High-density live equipment audit tracking quantities, conditions, and custody locations.
- [Official Physical Audit Reporting](https://km100-inventory.local/#reports): Formal physical inventory sheets and multi-sheet audit workbooks for compliance.
